changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A sealed review's mailbox event names its review, job and admission instead of a provider source (ADR 0160). Each kind keeps to its own columns, a review has one event, and the review's deletion removes it.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event ALTER COLUMN binding_id DROP NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN native_event_id DROP NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN source_id DROP NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN source_ref DROP NOT NULL, ADD COLUMN workspace_id BIGINT, ADD COLUMN review_id UUID, ADD COLUMN job_id UUID, ADD COLUMN admission_digest VARCHAR(64); -- Each kind keeps to its own columns: a provider event names its source, a sealed review names its review. ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_kind_shape CHECK ( (kind = 'REVIEW_SEALED' AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND job_id IS NOT NULL AND admission_digest IS NOT NULL AND binding_id IS NULL AND native_event_id IS NULL AND source_id IS NULL AND source_ref IS NULL AND request_id IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'REVIEW_SEALED' AND binding_id IS NOT NULL AND native_event_id IS NOT NULL AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND source_ref IS NOT NULL AND workspace_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND job_id IS NULL AND admission_digest IS NULL)); ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event ADD CONSTRAINT uk_mentor_event_review UNIQUE (review_id, workspace_id); -- A foreign key ignores row-level security, so the review's purge or retention removes its event for every owner. ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_mentor_event_review FOREIGN KEY (review_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES public.review (id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE; -- The kind and the disposition each accept exactly their enum, now with the sealed review's values. ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_mentor_event_kind; ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_kind CHECK (kind IN ('MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE_EDITED', 'MESSAGE_DELETED', 'CONTROL_STOP', 'REVIEW_SEALED')); ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_mentor_event_disposition; ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_disposition CHECK (disposition IN ('PENDING', 'OPENED', 'REVISED', 'FENCED', 'RECORDED'));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT sfk_mentor_event_review
ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT uk_mentor_event_review
ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_kind_shape
ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_kind CHECK (kind IN ('MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE_EDITED', 'MESSAGE_DELETED', 'CONTROL_STOP'))
ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_disposition, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_disposition CHECK (disposition IN ('OPENED', 'REVISED', 'FENCED', 'RECORDED'))

ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP COLUMN admission_digest, DROP COLUMN job_id, DROP COLUMN review_id, DROP COLUMN workspace_id, ALTER COLUMN source_ref SET NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN source_id SET NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN native_event_id SET NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN binding_id SET NOT NULL
